payload.text: ST0002/WP05 follow-up and two WP08 fixes, on vc's verdicts of 2026-11-13, one commit set riding cc's WP04 run (no run of its own); vc closes WP05 and WP07 once it lands. (a) Predict's tier grouping: predict counts the plan most of the accounts the rule can use record, subscriptionType and rateLimitTier compared whole; a tie goes to the active account's plan, else to the lexically first (cc's meaning); every other usable account is left out as another plan's allowance; the text and README drop the one-plan assumption; the burn rate counts only that plan's accounts' samples (put to cc to sign). (b) herdr::check names the cause when herdr-app cannot be started for any reason but not being found. (c) herdrs_own narrowed so a hidden directory, eg a .git, counts as an edit and is refused without --force. Written on main (cc's follow-up landed as 26f373f..ed77832), unbuilt; cc gets the commits and a mutants script before its WP04 slot.
